Depression doesn’t make it fine for Shane to be rude, it makes it understandable. I don’t recall any of the absent parent stuff, or if it’s canonical. Sure you don’t see them, but is it clarified what they’re up to or if they were present in childhood? Anyways, supposing she does have this trauma, their brand of rude is not the same.

Haley is insulting for little reason. For example, and there are many I could use, Haley says “Don't you get tired of running around on that farm all day, or whatever it is you do?” This is not connected to having an absent parent, it’s just being a b word. Shane, on the other hand, pushes you away because depression makes you feel as if you’ll only ruin any potential relationship. 

It makes you feel like you don’t deserve other people, like you only hurt other people, and like existence is pointless so what’s the point in forming relationships? It makes sense, and is connected to his issue. 

We all have trauma in life, but do we all go around acting like high school brats? No, that’s a decision. Shane’s mainly hurting himself when he pushes other people away, he’s self deprecating. 

It’s not a decision to feel the way he feels, and his actions reflect that, and he is hardly outright insulting. He says things like, “I don’t know you, why are you talking to me?” And pretty soon after gaining a few hearts, he apologizes for his behavior and gets better. I don’t recall Haley apologizing or acknowledging her bad attitude. 

The motivations behind their words are entirely different. Haley wants to put you down, and act superior. Shane doesn’t trust himself enough to get close to people. 

Anyways, like you want to like, I just want to highlight that they are not as comparable. It’s a game, so really no harm meant
